name: research-entity
description: Board-ready competitive-intelligence and due-diligence dossiers on any legal entity — company, startup, or vendor. 23-section report: executive briefing (BLUF, scorecard, SWOT, threat heat map, strategic playbook, monitoring watchlist), founders, funding, product and technical architecture, pricing, customers, competition, community reception, security posture, and an 8-pattern red-flag risk scan. Every datapoint cross-validated against multiple free public sources, hallucination-audited, mermaid render-validated, with HTML/PDF/battle-card/VC-memo export.

interface.shortDescription: Competitive-intel and due-diligence dossiers on any company
interface.longDescription: Drop in a company name: the skill gathers evidence from free public sources, cross-validates every datapoint, labels aggregator-only data, and returns a 23-section board-ready dossier with confidence scoring and an always-on red-flag scan.
